title: Enterprise Connectivity: net permission rounding
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this net permission rounding rule to invoice ceiling acceptance.

## Basis: outcome
For invoice ceiling acceptance, when the source tax treatment is verified exemption the ceiling remains a net amount with no tax uplift; for other supported tax treatments it is still the net ceiling and the statutory tax is separate. Round only this final ceiling half-up to the source tier’s monetary precision.

## Basis Q&A
| Invoice ceiling acceptance basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Invoice ceiling acceptance: When the source tax treatment is verified exemption the ceiling remains a net amount with no tax uplift | for other supported tax treatments it is still the net ceiling and the statutory tax is separate. Round only this final ceiling half-up to the source tier’s monetary precision. |

## Hypothetical calculation
A hypothetical net permission amount of USD 12.345, with two-decimal monetary precision, rounds half-up to USD 12.35. A verified exemption does not turn this net permission into a tax-inclusive amount.
